transcript: I used Mira Cabs in Kochi for two days. She provides taxis in Kochi. The driver was polite and waited during stops, but arrived late on the second day. I think I paid about 900 rupees for an evening ride. Fine if you are not on a tight schedule.
Asha is a fountain pen restorer. She repaired my old pen in Udaipur. It writes smoothly now. I only tried a nib repair, so I cannot say how she handles other damage.
I bought the Trail Mug. It keeps tea warm for four hours. The lid leaks if I put it sideways, so I only carry it upright. I would not put it loose in a bag.
Nisha suggested the film Paper Boats, but I have not watched it. She said the ending was moving. I read the book Quiet Roads myself. The short chapters were lovely, but the ending felt rushed.
Maine Saffron Cafe Jaipur mein try kiya. Chai achhi thi, lekin service slow thi. Weekend par jaldi ho toh mat jaana. Do doston ke saath baithne ke liye achha tha.
required_meaning: slow on visit, no busy weekends invention

transcript: I took the pottery class at River Studio last month. The teacher was patient, and beginners got plenty of help. Bring an apron because clay splashes. There were stairs, and I do not know if there is a lift.

I use Pocket Ledger to track household expenses. Entry is quick and the totals are easy to read. Export failed twice last week, so I still keep a separate spreadsheet. I cannot recommend it as the only copy of your records.
I attended a weaving workshop at Cedar House in May. The teacher was patient with my mistakes. We used cotton thread, but I have never tried wool there. I think the session cost about 700 rupees.
